text: {"lessons":["Selling B and C early, then buying B again at a much higher price, reminds me not to let the discomfort of realizing a loss—or the satisfaction of realizing a gain—drive decisions; reassess each holding on its current merits.","I made no trades through several sizable account swings, then added multiple positions at once. I should use a consistent review and rebalancing process rather than letting daily checking or a sudden urge to act dictate trade timing.","Before placing several buys together, I should check how they affect total exposure and preserve enough cash for flexibility; diversification matters, but adding positions is not automatically risk reduction."]}
